# Tif's Pool Care

> Professional pool maintenance and repair services in Southwest Florida. Licensed, Bonded & Insured. CPO Certified. Woman-Owned. Serving residential and commercial clients with 20+ years of industry experience.

## About

Tif's Pool Care is a woman-owned pool service company based in Arcadia, Florida, founded and operated by Tiffany, a Certified Pool Operator (CPO) with over 20 years of experience in the pool care industry. We provide reliable, professional pool maintenance, repair, and resurfacing services across Southwest Florida.

## Services

- **Weekly Pool Maintenance**: Regularly scheduled cleaning, chemical balancing, skimming, filter checks, and equipment inspections to keep pools safe and swim-ready year-round.
- **Seasonal Care**: Specialized pool care programs tailored to Florida's climate, including summer preparation, off-season maintenance, and storm recovery.
- **Minor Repairs**: Pump repairs, filter replacements, leak detection, and other small equipment fixes handled quickly and affordably.
- **Pressure Washing**: Professional pressure washing for pool decks, patios, driveways, and surrounding outdoor areas.
- **Pool Resurfacing**: Complete pool surface restoration including replastering, pebble finishes, and refinishing to extend the life and appearance of your pool.
- **Emergency / Same-Day Service**: Urgent pool care when you need it most -- green pool recovery, equipment failures, and post-storm cleanup with same-day availability.

## Service Areas

Tif's Pool Care serves the following communities in Southwest Florida:

- Arcadia, FL (home base)
- Wauchula, FL
- Punta Gorda, FL
- Port Charlotte, FL
- Boca Grande, FL
- Rotunda, FL
- Englewood, FL
- Expanding to Sarasota, FL and Fort Myers, FL

## Credentials

- Licensed, Bonded & Insured
- CPO Certified (Certified Pool Operator)
- Woman-Owned Business
- 20+ Years of Experience
